description: Defines the Game class for a Tic Tac Toe game, including properties for game state and methods for gameplay logic.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Represents a Tic Tac Toe game with properties for game state and methods to manipulate and check the game.

methods.name: PlaceMark
methods.description: Places a mark on the board if valid, increments the move count.

methods.name: CheckWin
methods.description: Checks for a win and updates the status and winner accordingly.

methods.name: CheckDraw
methods.description: Checks and updates the draw status if the board is full with no winner.
